Recommended semester (the semester in which students are advised to take the course)
3rd year, 1st semester → 2nd year, 2nd semester

- From the 2026 academic year, the recommended semester changes to the 2nd semester of the 2nd year.
- As a transitional measure, in the 2026 academic year only, the course will be offered in both the 2026 1st semester and the 2026 2nd semester. (In the 2026 1st semester, students in their 3rd year take it as their recommended semester; in the 2026 2nd semester, students in their 2nd year take it as their recommended semester.)
- From the 2027 academic year, the course will be offered in the 2nd semester. (From the 2027 2nd semester, students in their 2nd year take it as their recommended semester.)

Major required elective (전선필) → Major required (전필)
Credits-lecture hours-lab hours
(3-2-2 → 4-2-4)

For students who entered in 2018 or later (2018학번, entering class year), this is a 4-credit major required course.
Because this course is offered as a 4-credit major required course, students who entered before 2018 will receive 4 credits,
but since it is not 'major required' for them, they must apply for a course classification change (교과구분변경) to change it to 'major elective (전선)'.
